messages:
alyssa: quick sync — mobile SDKs are inflating trace cardinality and upload bytes. customer asks for a lightweight trace header + offline buffering contract. thoughts?

mika: +1, been seeing huge tag churn from mobile. short-term we can strip verbose attrs and rely on server-side enrichment. long-term we should define a compact propagation header.

dan: can you sketch what "compact" means? small as in bytes or small as in fields?

mika: small bytes. idea: 64- to 128-bit header carrying trace_id suffix + sampling bits + tenant-id-hash. server can rehydrate full context if it has the rest. example: `X-RD-MOB: v1:base64(trace_suffix|flags|tenant_hash)`

priya: concern: tenant_hash still increases cardinality if we use raw tenant ids. use a stable 8-bit bucketed hash for billing attribution to avoid explosion.

samir: also offline: mobile buffers events and uploads on wifi. we need idempotency + dedupe keys. header should include a monotonic session nonce so server can collapse duplicates.

mika: agree. proposed header fields: `tsuf(48) | flags(8) | thash(8) | sNonce(32)` → total ~96 bits. base64 encode → ~16 bytes.

dan: tradeoffs: smaller header reduces traffic and privacy surface, but server-side enrichment needs to be deterministic. How do we reattach original attributes for debugging?

alyssa: debug mode could opt-in: SDK adds a signed short upload containing expanded attrs for the next N uploads. default path keeps it compact.

priya: regulatory note: for EU customers with data residency we can't shard tenant attribution to US-only enrichment. must ensure enrichment happens in-region. add region tag bit in flags.

mika: good catch — add a 4-bit region id in flags. still fits.

infra-bot: deployment-note: will need a small change to trace-ingest to accept `X-RD-MOB` and route to mobile-enricher. Rolling change with feature flag recommended.

samir: sampling interactions: if mobile samples aggressively, billing attribution becomes noisy. We should define a sampling-propagation rule: SDK reports `sample_rate` in session metadata upload, server uses weighted attribution.

dan: next steps: I'll draft a short RFC covering header spec, server enrichment contract, offline dedupe, region constraints, and a feature-flag rollout plan. tagging folks to review — @mika @priya @samir @alyssa

alyssa: thanks. can we also prototype a byte-count comparison between current SDK and compact header within two sprints? product wants numbers.

mika: I'll run a small A/B on 500k sessions and post results here.

dan: timeline: RFC this week, prototype next 2 weeks, canary rollout behind flag in 3–4 weeks.

alyssa: perfect. logging: add a metric `mobile.header.size_bytes` so we can measure improvement.

priya: and add integration tests to assert region routing for EU tenants.

samir: lgtm.

alyssa: closing loop — thanks everyone :thumbsup:
